1.head: Three goals before the first intermission
1.body: Up 3-0 after one and 8-3 after two, we never looked back against Blackout. Vaughn Labelle had the hat trick and six different players scored. Matt Stephens took the only penalty of the night.

3.head: Down 5-1, then the lights came on
3.body: The Ice Goats led 5-1 in the first period and 5-3 at the first intermission. We outscored them 7-2 the rest of the way. Johnathan Bursey had a hat trick (one on the power play) and six points, and Kolton Jordison added five.

4.head: Three goals against, then a shutout
4.body: Smokin Guns scored three in the first period and nothing after that. We answered with seven unanswered. Bryce Schneider has played one game for us this season and scored three, one of them shorthanded, and Labelle had a hat trick of his own.

5.head: The second period was a bad idea
5.body: We led 2-1 after the first. The Ducks scored four in the second and that was that. Labelle, Darryl Folkerson and Adam Lamoureux got our three goals.

6.head: Nine against, seven for, one penalty
6.body: A back-and-forth game that the Mustangs took 9-7, with BJ Gurba scoring a hat trick. Kyle Haugrud and Adam Durham each scored twice for us. The only penalty of the night went to the Mustangs.

7.head: Taylor Edwards scored all four and still lost
7.body: Blackout's Edwards scored all four of their goals. We trailed 2-1 after one, tied it 4-4 after two and scored twice in the third. Mike Leibel and Taylor Anderson each had two goals.

8.head: Four from Kenton, and Kyle set up every one
8.body: Kenton Haugrud scored four, and Kyle Haugrud had an assist on all four. It wasn't enough against Colts, who won 7-5 behind a Ryder Terpstra hat trick. We never led, and the Colts took both penalties.

9.head: Season high: eleven
9.body: We led 5-2 after one and 9-2 after two, and finished 11-4. Anderson, Durham, Labelle, Kyle Haugrud and Kenton Haugrud each scored twice, and one of Kyle's was shorthanded.

10.head: Won on an empty-netter
10.body: Michael Kesslering scored a hat trick, including a power-play goal, in an 8-7 game that was tied 3-3 after one. Folkerson's empty-netter with 1:37 left made it 8-6, and Smokin Guns scored with 54 seconds to go.

11.head: Seven goals against in the first period
11.body: The Ducks led 7-2 after one, and Danny Arnold had four, the last one his 19th of the season. We outscored them 5-3 the rest of the way, which would have been nice if the game had started in the second.

12.head: Three shorthanded goals against
12.body: We scored five in the second period, two on the power play. The Mustangs scored three shorthanded goals and Tyson Walker had four, so the 10-7 loss was decided on special teams. Four penalties each.

13.head: Down 6-1 after the first
13.body: Steve Holford scored four for Blackout (12 on the season) as they led 6-1 after one. We won the second and third periods 6-5 combined, but the game ended 11-7. It finished with roughing minors on Lee Brown and Cody Cross.
